question: A motorist travels 30 km in 50 minutes. He drives at a speed of x km/hr for the first 12 minutes, then at 2x km/hr for the next 22 minutes and finally at x km/hr for the remainder of the journey. Determine the value of x.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time = 50 min ⇒ 12 + 22 + 16

Distance = x×(12/60) + 2x×(22/60) + x×(16/60)

⇒ Total = (12x + 44x + 16x)/60 = 72x/60 = 6x/5

Given total distance = 30 ⇒ 6x/5 = 30

**∴ Answer = x = 25 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 30 km, Total time = 50 minutes

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Convert time into hours

⇒ 12 min = 12/60 hr, 22 min = 22/60 hr, 16 min = 16/60 hr

⇒ Distance₁ = x × (12/60) = 12x/60

⇒ Distance₂ = 2x × (22/60) = 44x/60

⇒ Distance₃ = x × (16/60) = 16x/60

⇒ Total distance = (12x + 44x + 16x)/60 = 72x/60

⇒ 72x/60 = 30

⇒ 6x/5 = 30

⇒ x = 25 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 25 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Distance Formula

Distance = Speed × Time is the base relation in motion problems.

Time Conversion

Minutes must be converted to hours by dividing by 60.

Piecewise Motion

Total distance = sum of distances in each segment.

Average Speed Concept

Average speed = Total distance / Total time.
